summary: All six owned census classes repaired through their shared paths, validated by the filtered sweep over every owned operator (all checks PASS) plus the full test suite. (1) LICM: the TIR scope rule is name-based, and a hoisted op whose RESULT name the loop body rebinds leaves the remaining in-body uses resolving against the body's binding (implicit_conv2d's reshape named 'rs' vs the srem carrying source alias 'rs', 6 identities) -- a100c/passes/licm.py now declines a hoist whose result scope name is bound by another body value (op results, join results, nested carried names); the TIR verifier stays the control and the witness test reproduces the exact break with the check disabled. (2) The mask-typed value path never reads .sew: logical.not/bit.invert on an i1 block lowers to the new 'vmnot' MIR op (one mask in, one mask out; mir.py opcode+verifier branch, repertoire row emitted vmnand.mm m,m because the pinned binutils has no vmnot.mm pseudo -- probed: unrecognized opcode), and mask compares/_open_region refuse located; the fp32 amp operator now builds a real ELF with the source-attributed vmnand. (3) _splat_const packs float identities as IEEE bits at SEW 16/32/64 (the fp64 max-index identity -inf crashed int(); 16-bit refuses located without the fp16/bf16 TIR type instead of encoding wrong bits). (4) driver._load_source unwraps the autotuner chain recursively (Autotuner.fn = JITFunction, .fn.fn = the raw function), so the 11 @triton.autotune operators load their compile unit; the config stays the specialization's deterministic first-declared pick. (5) The grid-model interpreter's multi-dimensional element subscripts (x[1, -1]) degrade to untracked instead of int() over a tuple. (6) 'x is [not] None' folds on the traced argument's presence (pinned semantics) before the runtime guard, and a non-folding identity comparison refuses located naming the construct. Full-corpus re-run: crash 22 -> 0, 'case' 63 -> 0, '_make_case' 8 -> 0, 'literal' 9 -> 0, artifacts 416 -> 427; the sweep still exits 1 on two pre-existing non-owned findings identical to the pre-task census (1 over-budget identity matmul_k32_splitn2_kernel_af4f712c at the 120s bound; 78 unlocated refusals in the tl.arange/allocation/const classes, down from 141 which included the 63 'case' rows this task removed).
